diagonal.name: Diagonal Reading
diagonal.description: the mind skips every other word.

finger.name: The Guiding Finger
finger.description: the eye no longer goes back.

voice.name: The Silenced Voice
voice.description: no inner voice to slow things down.

lectern.name: The Stone Lectern
lectern.description: a block torn from a railing.

ladder.name: The Rolling Ladder
ladder.description: reading the high shelves without coming down.

cornee.name: The Dog-Eared Page
cornee.description: a fold gives me back the page where I was.

metronome.name: The Metronome
metronome.description: it keeps the beat; my eyes follow.

wheel.name: The Book Wheel
wheel.description: twenty volumes turning before my eyes.

lift.name: The Book Lift
lift.description: books from other floors come up to me.

automaton.name: The Reading Automaton
automaton.description: it understands nothing, but it reads.

clock.name: The Gallery Clock
clock.description: every hour, the whole gallery turns a page.

minitel.name: The Minitel
minitel.description: a box with a screen that answers when I type.

computer.name: The Home Computer
computer.description: it keeps a thousand books and forgets none.

search.name: The Search Engine
search.description: three words, and it gives me the right book.

crawler.name: The Crawler
crawler.description: it walks the galleries without me.

algorithm.name: The Babel Algorithm
algorithm.description: a number, and the book is already written.
